pcs.pc_description: Read the process sheet & drawing
Check and inspect the parts supplied for physical / dimensional variation
Check the documentation of all parts its identification with respect to documents.
Prepare Cylinder to be installed, check its certificate and install with bolting using proper tool and bolts.
Check whether the component having proper edge distance and other dimensions prior to carrying out operation.
Install hydraulics pipe connection to cylinder IN and OUT of hydraulic trolley.
Operate hydraulic trolley and ensure proper function of cylinder.
Prepare Suspension unit to be installed and check its certification. Remove hatch covers with screw gun and place hatch cover and screws in proper place.
Install cylinder bolting with suspension unit.
centralize the suspension unit and install shim according to it.
Drilled the holes to shim and make countersink on it and install shim with sealant, Riveting is to be carried out with proper gun.
Offer to inspect the working of suspension unit by operating trolley.
Prepare The Canopy to be used for matching and check its certification. Check marks on bubble and apply protective casing on it.
Operate hydraulic trolley and check the touching area of canopy and mark on it.
Trimmed touching area of canopy with speed gun and ensure proper clearance. Proper gap is to be maintained for sealing hose installation.
Repeat the operation until canopy fully matched and proper clearance done.
After final matching refer to inspection and proper clearance chart is to be filled and documented.
Install rollers according to technology with proper clearance and drilled the holes and bolted.
Offer to inspect the working of rollers by operating trolley.
Install Dowel Pins with liquid shim i.e. ZP-3. Holes are drilled and dowel pins to be bolted.
Offer to inspect the working of dowel pins by operating trolley.
Install Canopy Supports with help of drilling fixture, drilled the holes ensure proper clearance.
Install Proposer with help of template, drilled the holes and ensure proper clearance.
Final bolting of Canopy supports and pyro pusher has to be done with sealant.
Offer to inspect the working of canopy support and pyro pusher by operating trolley.
Install manual opening handle and manual mechanism according to technology.
Offer to inspect the working of manual opening mechanism by operating manual opening handle.
Install hook to suspension unit with help of filler gauge and proper gap to be maintained.
Offer to inspect the gap of hook and reading should be documented.
Remove the canopy and fixed the canopy on sealing hose installation fixture.
Remove paint and other deburrs on sealing hose channel.
Apply protective cloth with help of glue in sealing hose channel.
Clean the sealing hose according to technology and apply glue to install sealing hose in channel.
Fixture has to install to hold the sealing hose tightly apply pressure in sealing hose to pressurize it.
Offer to inspect the final installation of sealing hose.
Finally install all canopy covers with help of screw and inspect proper safety of screw
Apply non corrosive paste on trimming surface and get primer on that.
Mark red marking on moving part.
